he.text: שׁוֹמֵר גּוֹי אֶחָד שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית עַם אֶחָד וְאַל־יֹאבַד גּוֹי אֶחָד הַמְיַחֲדִים שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד׃

en.text: O Guardian of an only nation, preserve the remnant of an only people, and suffer not that only nation to perish, which thus acknowledgeth the unity of thy name, “The Eternal our God, the Eternal is One.”
